paragraphs.text: Water Scarcity in Pakistan. Water is the lifeblood of Pakistan. This essay argues that the country now faces a serious water crisis that threatens farming, the economy and public health, and that it needs storage, better pricing and cooperation between provinces.

Agriculture uses about ninety percent of the water that Pakistan withdraws. The Indus Basin Irrigation System is one of the largest in the world, but canals leak and farmers still flood their fields. Wheat and cotton need far more water than the system can supply in a dry year.

Many people say that building big dams is the only solution. However, small dams, lined canals and drip irrigation can save water at lower cost. The Indus Waters Treaty with India also limits what Pakistan can do on the eastern rivers.
Rainfall is erratic and glaciers are melting. Everybody knows that something must be done. Throughout history great nations have solved their problems through unity and hard work.
In conclusion, Pakistan must store more water, charge a fair price for it and work with India under the treaty.

fixes.title: Create a formal essay outline
fixes.body: Examiners expect a structured roadmap to evaluate your logical flow. Without an outline, your arguments may appear disjointed. Before writing, draft a brief plan listing your thesis statement, key thematic headings for each paragraph, and a summary of your concluding thoughts to ensure a coherent progression of ideas.

fixes.title: Deepen your analytical arguments
fixes.body: General observations lack the critical depth required for high-level essays. To improve, move beyond stating that water scarcity is a problem. Instead, analyze the systemic failures in water governance or policy implementation. Connect these specific institutional weaknesses to the broader socio-economic impacts on Pakistan's agricultural stability.

fixes.title: Incorporate specific empirical evidence
fixes.body: Examiners look for precise data to substantiate your claims. General statements about agriculture are insufficient. Support your arguments by citing specific figures from the latest Pakistan Economic Survey regarding water usage efficiency or data from the Indus River System Authority on current reservoir storage levels to demonstrate a rigorous understanding.
